downloads.allowed: IDEA-Research/Rex-Omni weights via domestically reachable mirrors (hf-mirror / ModelScope; both returned 200 in the phase-0 audit).
downloads.required: Record sha256 and byte size for every downloaded file on arrival. A download that is not digest-recorded did not happen, as far as any later claim is concerned.
downloads.awq_variant: Permitted if faster, but using it MUST be recorded in the result artifact — the AWQ variant is a different object under test, not a deployment detail.
downloads.transport_disclosure: If the requested domestic mirror redirects abroad, disclose it and do not claim domestic delivery — as was done for the PR-Bench materialization.

service_lifecycle: Start, probe, then STOP the service and verify it is stopped (PID, listener, compute processes, watchdog, GPU memory). Same shape as the 2c incumbent probe, which stopped clean.

must_be_identical_to_the_incumbent_run: source-resolution images and the XYXY adapter
comparability_is_the_binding_constraint.only_permitted_variable: The model-visible prompt, which must follow Rex-Omni's own format. It must be recorded verbatim in the result artifact, because it is the single allowed difference and therefore the single alternative explanation for any gap.
comparability_is_the_binding_constraint.preregistration: Freeze prompt, adapter, and subset identity into a create-once preregistration artifact BEFORE the first successful inference, exactly as the incumbent run did. No post-hoc backfill.

mandatory_result_fields: parsed / malformed / absent, with conservation to 600
malformed RATE — the incumbent's is 186/600 = 31%. This is likely the more informative comparison than the score itself: it answers whether the model can reliably emit a box at all.
six per-category scores and the strict micro overall
ceiling on the same screen: 181 rows in conflicting-GT groups; 11 groups with min pairwise GT IoU < 0.5; global min 0.0
omission-bias counterfactual: if Rex-Omni's malformed rate is also material, compute its inflation factor and place it beside the incumbent's 1.449x

adoption_rule_as_amended_2026_09_01.rule: A candidate must (1) beat the incumbent on the identical subset and conditions, AND (2) be reported with the incumbent's 31% malformed rate and 1.449x omission inflation on the same screen.
adoption_rule_as_amended_2026_09_01.why_amended: The incumbent scores 0.0589 with 31% malformed. Almost any pointing-specialised model beats that, so beat-incumbent alone stopped being evidence of fitness. tzb-fe wrote the original rule assuming a meaningful opponent; that assumption did not hold.
adoption_rule_as_amended_2026_09_01.forbidden_claim: A low-scoring opponent is not capability evidence. The incumbent is a general VL model, not pointing-specialised; its low score must never be cited as 'our 27B has poor vision' — that is a different claim this experiment does not support.

stop_lines: The data requires the model to emit an ID absent from its input — STOP. That is the frozen visual family's defect and must not be rebuilt.
Training or fine-tuning becomes necessary to run it at all — STOP and report. Do not start training.
Any comparability condition must be relaxed to make it run — STOP and report. Better no number than an incomparable one.
Any step needs a host, card, or write path not named above — STOP and escalate.
reporting: Report the moment the number exists; do not batch. Freeze is 2026-09-03 and this is the only remaining candidate for a positive capability figure in the presentation materials.
deadline_reality: If this lands, it is a current observation outside the externally reviewed CLAIMS-SHEET.
